verdict.rationale: Microsoft Authenticator is an end-user mobile app for MFA, passwordless sign-in, passkeys and Verified IDs. A sandbox or test environment for isolating work from production data is a developer-platform axis that does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the app offering any test mode, test tenant or sandbox, and probes found no API surface either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
